video.title: AI欧腐《救命！我怀了狮王的崽/Help! The Lion King Knocked Me Up》
video.desc:
你们知道的
My name is Oliver, a rabbit beastman. I was one hundred percent sure I was straight—until five months, I got forcefully "marked" by a dominant lion king in heat, Leon Norman, the ruthless ruler of the beast empire. I thought it was just a wild, one-night mistake. But plot twist: I, a fully-grown male rabbit, got knocked up. And we are talking about triplets!
我叫 Oliver，是一名兔族兽人。我曾经百分之百确定自己是直男，直到五个月前，我被一头正处于发情期的强势狮王强行"标记"了。他就是 Leon Norman，兽人帝国冷酷无情的统治者。我本以为那只是一夜荒唐的错误。结果剧情反转：我，一只成年公兔，居然怀上了。而且还是三胞胎！
